payload.claim: The "What the lock does, measured" section honestly states that the cross-process lock release under SIGKILL was measured on Darwin but "is not measured on Linux." This is standard POSIX flock behavior (a held flock is released when the holding descriptor's last reference closes, which happens unconditionally on process death including SIGKILL), so the risk of this not holding in the Linux build/test environment is low, but the spec itself flags the measurement gap rather than asserting it as verified fact on the target platform.
